judgement.title: APM PMS Q&A SOP: the session run on Monday 26 October 2026 on Friday 23 October's closing prices, for your session on Tuesday 27 October
judgement.heading: Avanza | Middle Innings Core Investment, no sell signal | 0.50% of the fund's capital in 1 tranche in the Position Management System; about 3.07% with your purchase of 16 October
judgement.markdown:
- **Industry:** Avanza is in Financials. Financials' Industry RS was 59 at the Friday 23 October reading (79 four weeks earlier)
- **Sector:** Avanza is in Digital investment and trading platforms. That sector's Sector RS was 67 at the 30 September month-end (84 at the August month-end); on Friday's daily reading it was 25
  - Avanza's sector's other companies, with their daily Stock RS: Fineco (33), Nordnet (54), Swissquote (10), IG Group (2), XTB (96), Flatex (2), and 3 more
- **Cohort:** Avanza is in Online brokers and investment platforms. The cohort's relative strength was 31 on Friday's daily reading (53 four weeks earlier). Avanza's cohort's other companies: Fineco (33), Nordnet (54), Swissquote (10), Flatex (2), AJ Bell (62), Integrafin (46)
- **Avanza's charts are on Avanza's page on the PMS Per-stock Dashboard:** https://vfhqi.github.io/ratings/pms/holding.html?t=AZA-SE

**What is going on, and why it matters**
- **The price move, by beta:** over twenty sessions Avanza's shares fell about 8%; Avanza's beta of 0.89 explains almost none of it, so Avanza's own move was about -7%, 1.1 times its usual size
- **The sector:** Avanza's sector's companies fell about 6% over the same twenty sessions, so most of the Avanza fall is the online brokers' fall; Avanza closed Friday about 3% below its 200-day moving average (SEK 360.9)
- **The analysts:** for Avanza, Net Upgrade Breadth, sales estimates was +22% and Net Upgrade Breadth, target prices +24% at the 30 September month-end, down from +88% and +79% at the August month-end
- **The new memo of 25 October (published this morning)** says Avanza's 2027 is the trough year of Avanza's five-year earnings path and that the analysts' estimates have not yet priced it (section below)

**What it means for the position**
- **Holding:** hold Avanza to the 30 October reading; no Sell Criterion is met at the readings the rule uses
- **Selling:** on Friday's daily readings Avanza's Sector RS (25) and Stock RS (37) both meet the Sell Criterion of Sector RS below 50 together with Stock RS below 70; I put an Avanza sell signal on 30 October as very likely
  - Avanza still carries your one-off in/out link in the status file, so that signal would wait for a purchase unless you remove the link (decision 3 in section 7)
- **Adding:** no further add; Avanza fails both of your add tests (Avanza is below its 50-day moving average, which is not rising, and the analysts' counts are narrowing)

**What we could lose:** about 0.36% of the fund's capital with the 16 October purchase (0.06% on the Position Management System as it stands), if Avanza's price falls to its relative 52W high trigger at about SEK 308.5, about 12% below Friday's close of SEK 349.70

**Experiment: which stocks Avanza's own moves have tracked** (last 3 and 6 months)
- **Nordnet** (same sector, cohort and country of listing): 0.66 and 0.68, strong
- **AJ Bell** (same sector and cohort): 0.58 and 0.30, moderate
- **Creades** (same country of listing): 0.48 and 0.35, moderate
- **Swissquote** (same sector and cohort): 0.44 and 0.38, moderate
- **My reading:** look at Nordnet first; Avanza and Nordnet trade as one bet on Swedish retail savings

**The Investment Analyst's new memo on Avanza (written 25 October at SEK 360.10, published 26 October; read from the memo's summary, because the new memo has no separate digest)**
- **Decided:** the new memo on Avanza says "prepare now and size after the estimates reset": a top-decile franchise is entering the weakest eighteen months of its earnings path, and the case is about when, not whether
- **Must happen:** income per customer back above SEK 2,300 a year (below SEK 2,050 the memo's base needs cutting), and the Riksbank's expected rate rise on 4 November passed through to Avanza's interest income
- **Main risk:** two more rounds of estimate cuts (the January compilation and the 22 January results), with a fourth-quarter miss into unrevised numbers able to take the shares to SEK 310 to SEK 330
- **Expected return (the Modal return):** about 13% a year at today's multiple, and about 18% a year to mid-2029 on the memo's own fair multiple of 19.5 times, both below our bar of 20% a year; the memo's fair trough band is SEK 310 to SEK 345, just below Friday's close
- **Next test:** the Riksbank decision on 4 November, then Avanza's fourth-quarter results on 22 January 2027

**My judgement:** bearish on the Avanza position into the 30 October reading, medium to high conviction: hold it to the reading, and expect the rule to sell it
- The new memo agrees with the rule on timing: the memo's own advice is to wait for the estimate cuts before sizing, which is what a sale on 30 October and a re-entry after 22 January would do
- **Counter-case:** the memo puts the downside on the multiple as small (a fair trough band just below Friday's close), so a sale at the 3 November session may sell near the bottom of the band; the memo's skew turns positive by spring 2027

**What would change my view:** Avanza's Stock RS and Sector RS at the 30 October month-end; the Riksbank decision on 4 November

items.criterion: MA SLs: each tranche's MA less 2%, information only for a Middle Innings Core Investment

bullets.text: Avanza is a Middle Innings Core Investment, so its MA SLs sell nothing; its six Sell Criteria decide the sale.
Avanza's tranche 1 had a 150D MA SL exit confirmed on 20-Oct, and Avanza closed 2.9% below tranche 1's 365.32 stop on 27-Oct.
No Avanza close since 20-Oct has regained tranche 1's 150D MA SL; the nearest, 360.1 on 21-Oct, was 1.2% short.

items.criterion: Sector RS below 50 with Stock RS below 70, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal yet, but one is very likely at the 30-Oct month-end: on 27-Oct Avanza's Sector RS was 24 and Avanza's Stock RS 33.
A Sector RS with Stock RS sell signal at the 30-Oct month-end sells the whole Avanza holding under your one-off in/out link, when its replacement is bought.
Whether Avanza sells on Tuesday 3-Nov or later is your ruling on keeping or removing the one-off in/out link on Avanza and Helios Towers.

items.criterion: Stock RS below 50 with revenue or PT Net Upgrade Breadth below zero, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal yet, but the 27-Oct readings would give one at the 30-Oct month-end: Avanza's Stock RS 33 and PT Net Upgrade Breadth (10.5%).
Only a 17-point rise in Avanza's Stock RS by 30-Oct, near Avanza's largest one-week rise (18), or Avanza's PT Net Upgrade Breadth back to zero would avoid that sell signal.
A Stock RS with Net Upgrade Breadth sell signal at the 30-Oct month-end sells the whole Avanza holding under your one-off in/out link.

items.criterion: The 200D MA of relative price flat or falling over the month, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal yet: Avanza's relative 200D MA was still rising but fading, +0.23% over the month at the 23-Oct reading.
At a flat relative price, Avanza's relative 200D MA would turn falling, a sell signal, on Friday 13-Nov, or by 6-Nov after a 5% fall in Avanza's relative price.
A sell signal from Avanza's relative 200D MA would add a further whole-holding sell signal under your one-off in/out link.

items.criterion: Relative price more than 25% below its 52W high, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Avanza's relative price was 15.2% below its 52W high on 27-Oct, against a 25% line, from 7.6% at 30-Sep.
Low: at a flat market, Avanza's relative price reaches the 25% line at 313.46, 11.6% below the 27-Oct close and 3.5 times Avanza's usual weekly move.
A month-end sell signal from Avanza's relative price sells the whole Avanza holding under your one-off in/out link, though Avanza's Sector RS with Stock RS very probably signals first.

items.criterion: A tranche 30% below its highest close since purchase, with Stock RS below 70

bullets.text: No sell signal: Avanza's 27-Oct close was 24.1% above tranche 1's 285.81 level, but Avanza's Stock RS (33) is already below 70.
An Avanza close below 285.81 would trigger tranche 1, so tranche 1 sells at the Tuesday session after its release, even under your one-off in/out link.
Avanza's 16-Oct purchase has no 30% level until entered, a step tied to your 28-Oct ruling on which MA the 16-Oct purchase follows.

items.criterion: Industry RS below 30, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal: Avanza's Industry RS (Financials) was 73 on 27-Oct, far above 30, after 59 at the 23-Oct reading.
If Avanza's Industry RS fell below 30 at a Friday reading, the rules would sell the whole Avanza holding under your one-off in/out link.

adds.criterion: The rules: no sell signal from the six Sell Criteria

bullets.text: No sell signal from any of the six Sell Criteria for Avanza at its last formal readings, Friday 23-Oct and the 30-Sep month-end.
At the 30-Sep month-end Avanza's Stock RS was 56, above 50, with its sector's Sector RS above 50 and Avanza's revenue and PT Net Upgrade Breadth positive.
Avanza's Sector RS with Stock RS and Stock RS with Net Upgrade Breadth were both sell signals on 28-Oct; either still on at the 30-Oct month-end blocks adds.

adds.criterion: The rules: room below the holding's limit

bullets.text: Avanza is 3.07% of capital, including your 16-Oct purchase of 2.57%, against the 6.68% limit for a Middle Innings Core Investment, leaving 3.61% of room.
The 6.68% limit only stops adds to Avanza and never forces a sale of Avanza.
Two 1.67% tranches would take Avanza to 6.41% of capital, leaving 0.27% of room under the 6.68% limit.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a positive retest of a rising MA

bullets.text: Avanza failed its test of the rising 200D MA, closing more than 2% below that MA on 22, 23 and 26-Oct and 1.8% below at 354.6 on 27-Oct.
Your 28-Oct note says Avanza's October volume "was much more negative than during any other pullback", though Avanza's up-to-down volume ratio was lower on 27-Apr (0.54) than on 27-Oct (0.65).
An Avanza close back above its 200D MA (361.12 on 27-Oct) on an up day with 1.5 times the 50D average volume or more would confirm a low.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a broadening of the case (momentum rising in guidance, sell-side estimates, technicals or peers)

bullets.text: Avanza's case is narrowing rather than broadening, with Avanza's technicals falling clearly and Avanza's sell-side turned mixed; guidance is not checked here.
By 28-Oct 6 of 19 analysts were cutting Avanza's FY2027 EPS and 7 cutting PTs, against none at 30-Sep, while Avanza's Stock RS fell from 56 to 34.
Avanza's Stock RS back above 50 with PT Net Upgrade Breadth above zero would end the narrowing; Avanza's 22-Jan-2027 results are the next test of Avanza's estimates.
Your 28-Oct note lists red flags for adding to Avanza: Avanza's "SP fell a lot more than Nordnet and the sector", and "I am out of step with the market".
Your 28-Oct note also says Avanza's ratio of down-day to up-day volume this month was "much more negative than during any other pullback".
Your 28-Oct note records the 16-Oct add to Avanza ("I added 2.57%"), which takes Avanza to 3.07% of capital.
